title: Transpose invariance under affine diagonal translation
statement: In the affine diagonal coordinate setup of lem-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-orientation, with the same P, Y, aY, d, r and hA and the displayed coordinate maps e and h, the transpose maps agree: P.affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose d p₁ aX r hA e he = P.affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose d p₁ aX r hA h hh.

source.place: Agreement on the model, translation clause; split of the two conjuncts

proof.text: The parent translation comparison is a conjunction; this node is its transpose projection. The compact-support exchange, normalized Tate pullback, and coordinate comparison give the displayed equality.

theorem affineDiagonalIntegration_translation_transpose (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated aY] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (d r : ℕ) (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : P.Coefficient) = 0) :
    let p := affineDiagonalProjection Y d
    let aX := p ≫ aY
    let p₁ := pullback.fst p p
    letI := affineDiagonalProjection_smooth Y d
    letI := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth d p
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P p₁ aX
    letI := (affineDiagonalProductCoordinates_spec Y d).1
    letI := (affineDiagonalTranslatedCoordinates_spec Y d).1
    let e := asIso (affineDiagonalProductCoordinates Y d)
    let h := asIso (affineDiagonalTranslatedCoordinates Y d)
    let he := (affineDiagonalProductCoordinates_spec Y d).2
    let hh := (affineDiagonalTranslatedCoordinates_spec Y d).2.1
    P.affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose d p₁ aX r hA e he =
        P.affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose d p₁ aX r hA h hh
